notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/healthcare-robotics__assistive-gym --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run. The card's helper and family were kept: HumanTestingEnv is served through GymnasiumDriver with cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1. NOT COVERED / not run: the upstream environment itself (PyBullet, Keras/TensorFlow, SMPL-X and the bundled assets are not installed where the gate runs, and package code never imports the clone); the sim backend (gym.make after importing assistive_gym) was not run. The fake is the package's own stand-in for HumanTestingEnv: it mirrors reset, step, seed and the two Box spaces, returns the empty observation and reward 0, and applies the 200-step TimeLimit of the Gym registration as truncated. Upstream HumanTestingEnv.step returns a four-tuple and never sets done; the fake returns the five-tuple form the bridge accepts so the time limit is visible as truncated. The declared 100 ms tick is one environment step (frame_skip=5 physics steps of time_step=0.02 s, env.py:21 and :224-226), not one PyBullet integration step. The action space is the 20 controllable human arm joints (right 0-9 plus left 10-19) and the observation space has length 0; the bridge derives both from the fake's spaces. Five warnings are expected of this Gymnasium family and are left: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only affects the next reset and produces no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the seeded integers and the derived action array (declaring the catalogue actions to add units was not done because the bridge derives the step schema and the family leaves these warnings). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
